newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos to sell gas to WMC Fertilizers.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos to sell gas to WMC Fertilizers.

text.p: Australian onshore gas producer Santos Ltd said on Thursday it had signed a contract for the sale of 127.5 petajoules of natural gas to WMC Ltd unit WMC Fertilizers.

Santos, which produces gas from the Cooper/Eromanga basins in South Australia and Queensland, said the contract was signed on behalf of the southwest Queensland producers and involved the supply of 8.5 petajoules each year for 15 years.
It said the contract was valued at about A$400 million at current prices.
The gas would be used at WMC's Phosphate Hill fertilizer project and the first sales were expected in January 2000 and set to end in December 2014.

WMC said earlier on Thursday that it would proceed with a A$650 million project to produce phosphate fertilizers in Queensland and announced an agreement with MIM Holdings Ltd for the supply of sulphur dioxide gas from MIM's Mount Isa copper smelter.
